# The panel token port keeps the theme example key while changing its CSS target

The example retains popup_affordance and maps it to --panel-background-color-dimmed, with the explanatory annotation updated to the same spelling. This separates the example's theme key from the implementation token name. The files are annotation documentation; they do not independently prove runtime theme-property handling. Preserve that local namespace boundary rather than applying the CSS rename to public or stored keys. No theme or UI test ran.

Scope: Theme annotation and panel-token naming scope.
